---
name: Earbuds request
about: Ask for full control of earbuds or headphones the app doesn't know yet
title: "Earbuds request: "
labels: device request
---

**Earbuds:** brand and model (like Anker Soundcore Liberty 5, A3957)

**Bluetooth name:** as it shows in your Bluetooth settings

**Wanted:** battery, noise cancelling, equalizer, touch controls, find my earbuds, fit test, something else

**Notes:** the brand's own app, what works there, what you miss
